title: Workspace Lattice: overview + folding patterns for sidebar, routes, and switcher
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: The Console has grown organically—multiple nav patterns (left rail, top tabs, popover switcher) create cognitive overhead and inconsistent access to dashboards, rollouts, and cost views.

Goal: Propose a unified information architecture and a compact ‘lattice’ sidebar pattern that surface workspace context, route prioritization, and quick switching, while preserving density for power users and discoverability for new users. Deliverables: interactive Figma prototype, annotated IA doc, handoff tokens, accessibility checklist, and two micro-usability sessions.

Success metrics: reduce time-to-open-most-used-route by 20%, 0 regressions in keyboard navigation, clear path for routing fallbacks (canary->stable), and developer feedback score >= 4/5 on the handoff-ready spec.
updates: 2025-02-14 — Kickoff: scoped to console left-rail replacement + workspace switcher reframe. Key stakeholders: PM (Jonas Müller), Eng lead (Ethan Brooks), SRE (Liu Wei). Agreed constraints: must support 4 depth levels of routes and prioritize rollouts/cost views in first fold.

2025-02-19 — Low-fi sketches completed. Two candidate patterns: (A) vertical lattice with persistent workspace breadcrumb, (B) stacked compact cards with contextual padding. Chose lattice: better for keyboard traversal and density.

2025-02-22 — Mid-fi Figma prototype v1: includes collapsed state (icons+progress microbars), expanded state (labels + micro-metrics for cost/latency), and an always-on workspace mini-preview. Prototype link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/workspace-lattice-v1 (internal)

2025-02-25 — Engineering review: concerns about route hydration cost when rendering micro-metrics for 100+ projects. Trade-off decided: lazy-load route metrics on first expansion + server-sent TTL cache. Added a non-blocking telemetry flag for rollout experiments. Github RFC PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/proposals/pull/289

2025-02-28 — Accessibility pass: ensured 1) focus ring preserved across collapsed/expanded states, 2) aria-expanded + aria-controls for each lattice node, 3) announcement on workspace switch via live region. Ran axe reports on prototype frames; two minor color contrast fixes applied.

2025-03-02 — Usability study (n=6 product engineers): tasks covered switching between 2 workspaces, finding active rollout, navigating to cost panel. Key outcomes: participants preferred mini-preview for multi-tenant context but wanted a keyboard shortcut (~) to open the switcher instantly. Action: add global hotkey and document in Console shortcuts.

2025-03-04 — Design review with PM + Eng: approved lattice for beta. Follow-ups: produce SVG icon set, define token spacing, and prepare a canary rollout UX (toast + fallback route suggestion) for runtime teams. Preparing handoff files and a short dev demo video.
